- **Output:** `/home/mara/cwe-bench/sibling2/out/screener/16287.json`. I re-checked the main citations against the pinned code.
- **Trust decision:** nothing separates user-authored config templates from text built at runtime. Every render uses one full set of template functions that includes `cmd`, `readFile`, `stat` and `glob` (`src/template/func_map.go:12-51`). So when `src/segments/path.go:285` renders `pt.Path` again, folder names become template code. The fix splits rendering into trusted and untrusted calls; only the path segment switches to untrusted, and every other change is a rename.
- **`pattern_fit`:** B, but weak. There is no second implementation: only `src/template` imports `text/template`. The route lever is minor: one more route into the template engine that only reads environment values.
- **Strongest lever:** in untrusted mode, the template engine still rewrites `.Env.X` to `(call .Getenv)` (`src/template/text.go:115-118`), so a folder name can still read environment variables. That holds even though the fix says untrusted renders lose `env`/`expandenv`, and a solver can dismiss it as not command execution. The parsed-template cache key also has to carry the trust level (`src/template/render.go:55-75`); that one needs the mechanism understood.
- **Biggest red flag:** none formally. The real weakness is a single behavioural site with a thin uncovered route, plus medium recall risk. Repo size wasn't measured.
